name: Dunnock
lateFeature: Brown wing scallops, fine slate breast pencil and long layered tail
anatomyNotes: Slender dark bill and plain grey breast contrast the streaked brown back. Long horizontally tapered tail and low compact head set a different gesture from upright tits.
